description: Clarifo helps users research stock-listed companies from Nordic and US public filings. The MCP tools support company snapshots, filing search, financial statement retrieval, peer comparison, screening, valuation analysis, ownership and insider activity lookup, governance research, reporting-standards answers, and generation of Clarifo-branded visual cards from user-authored stories.

defaultPrompt: Analyze Nokia’s latest quarter: key financial changes, filing drivers, and source-page citations.
Run a reverse DCF for Apple and explain what free-cash-flow growth the current share price implies.
Compare Helsinki and Stockholm construction companies on Q2 growth, margins, backlog, cash flow, and filing evidence.
